sample.title: CacheTray - Smart Clipboard Manager
sample.summary: CacheTray is a smart clipboard manager that automatically saves everything you copy — links, images, code snippets, and plain text — into a clean, searchable tray right in your browser. WHAT IT DOES • Auto-captures anything you copy (Ctrl+C) the moment you copy it • Stores links, images, code, tasks, and notes in one place • Organises items into Workspaces so work, personal, and research stay separate • Insert saved items into any website — Claude, ChatGPT, Twitter, Google Docs, and more • Bulk-select and insert or share multiple items at once • Re-copying something already saved bumps it to the top automatically • Open as a sidebar panel that stays visible while you browse FEATURES ✓ Auto-capture toggle — pause saving any time ✓ Workspaces — create separate trays for different projects ✓ Search — find any saved item instantly ✓ Categories — filter by links, images, code, tasks, or notes ✓ Favourites — pin important items ✓ Sidebar panel — stays open as you browse without losing your place ✓ Keyboard shortcut — open with Cmd+Shift+Y (Mac) / Ctrl+Shift+Y ✓ Right-click menu — save links, images, or selected text directly ✓ Auto-clears items older than 3 days to keep things fresh PRIVACY FIRST Everything stays on your device. No servers, no analytics, no accounts. Uninstalling permanently deletes all data. Perfect for researchers, developers, writers, and anyone who copies more than they can keep track of.
